title: Signature: Auditor-of-auditors
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the verifier's own checks are themselves logged in a meta-audit trail, which is verified by an independent routine. Trust in verification is earned recursively: each layer watches the one below, and the top layer's integrity is anchored externally. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers logging the verifier's own checks.

CFG = {1: 3, 2: 6, 3: 12}

title: Signature: Selective disclosure proofs
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the verifier can prove a specific entry exists in the log without revealing any other entry, using Merkle inclusion proofs over redacted trees. Auditors get the proof they need and nothing more. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers proving single entries without revealing others.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 8, 2: 16, 3: 32}
import hashlib
def h(s): return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
N, target = CFG[LEVEL], 3
leaves = [h("e%d" % i) for i in range(N)]
proof = []
idx, lvl = target, leaves
while len(lvl) > 1:
    sib = idx ^ 1
    proof.append(lvl[sib])
    lvl = [h(lvl[i] + lvl[i+1]) for i in range(0, len(lvl), 2)]
    idx //= 2
print("entries:", N, "| proof for entry", target, "reveals %d hashes, 0 other entries" % len(proof))
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Tamper bounty drills
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): on a schedule, a drill tampers with a copy of the audit log to verify the detector catches it. Drills that go undetected are treated as critical findings. The detector is only trusted because it is continuously tested. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers scheduled tampering drills on copies.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 3, 2: 6, 3: 10}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import hashlib
def h(s): return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
caught = 0
for drill in range(N):
    chain = [h("g%d-%d" % (drill, i)) for i in range(5)]
    chain[2] = "tampered"
    prev_ok = all(chain[i] == h("g%d-%d" % (drill, i)) for i in range(5))
    if not prev_ok: caught += 1
print("drills:", N, "| tampering caught:", caught, "| detector trusted:", caught == N)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
